source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_documented.habit: Deciduous shrub or small tree (Ilex genus description)
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate simple; larger flowering branch blades spatulate, oblanceolate or obovate, long-tapering base, pubescent along lower midrib; blades to 80 × 45 mm; petioles 2–11 mm
morphology_documented.flowers: Small, axillary, frequently unisexual, usually 4–5-merous (genus description)
morphology_documented.fruit: Bright red or orange drupaceous fruit to approximately 7.5 mm diameter, often persistent on leafless winter branches

source_scope_note: Genus-level traits are expressly indicated; absent species details not inferred.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Compare evergreen I. vomitoria with shorter petioles, evergreen leaves and different blade base
preservation: Additive record; original species.json, photos, credits and galleries unchanged
